entries.title: Gov. Wolf Announces $13.3 Million Investment in Chubb Insurance Creating More Than 1,250 Jobs in Philadelphia (52567088747).jpg
entries.description: Robert Zuritsky, President/CEO, Parkway speaks with the press. Governor Tom Wolf announced today that Chubb, the world’s largest publicly traded property and casualty insurance company, is planning a new Philadelphia office that will be the workplace for 3,200 employees. The company is investing $82 million into the project and will create at least 1,250 new, full-time jobs. Philadelphia, PA – December 16, 2022
entries.creator: Governor Tom Wolf from Harrisburg, PA
